description:
Broker Home Screen – Initial Implementation

h3. *Description*

Create the Broker Home Screen based on the provided Figma designs. This screen will serve as the main landing page for brokers after login and should display key actions and summary information.

h3. *Acceptance Criteria*

* Broker Home Screen matches Figma designs
* Displays broker welcome message
* Displays summary cards for:
** Active listings
** Pending deals
** Messages
* Clicking a summary card navigates to the appropriate page
* Screen is responsive on desktop and tablet
* Uses existing layout components

h3. *Design*

* [Figma link: |https://www.figma.com/design/049DL3s5yK6CdYuNygmHeX/Broker-App-White-Label?node-id=2072-43972&m=dev][_(link)_|https://www.figma.com/design/049DL3s5yK6CdYuNygmHeX/Broker-App-White-Label?node-id=2072-43972&m=dev]

h3. *Technical Notes*

* Use existing layout and card components where possible
* Follow current routing conventions

h3. *Out of Scope*

* Mobile-specific optimizations
* API pagination improvements
